section: Trust to Internet / Trust to DMZ / DMZ to Internet / Internet to DMZ
content:
# Trust to Internet / Trust to DMZ / DMZ to Internet / Internet to DMZ

Expected:

- Route through WAN
- Source NAT
- trust -> untrust permit policy

Expected:

- Directly connected routing
- trust -> dmz security policy
- No NAT normally required

Expected:

- Default route
- Source NAT
- dmz -> untrust policy

Expected:

- Destination NAT
- untrust -> dmz security policy
- Stateful session
- Return traffic through SRX
